title: Recipe step readiness
current: Every terminal recipe step that sends keys declares the ready_text of the prompt it answers; saving the case and starting its execution both refuse a keyed step without it, naming the step. A prompt that never appears fails that step as terminal_action_not_ready with step and waiting_for. When the command under the terminal has already exited, the step, including the browser approval gate, fails as terminal_setup_exited, and setup_exit names the exit code and the last named refusal setup printed. Linux reads the __YOKE_EXIT_ marker and stops waiting once it appears; macOS reads the recipe's exit-status file. A step for a prompt the installer no longer shows is removed from the source cases and the saved plan is synced.
desired: A live installer campaign run on a synced saved plan in which every keyed step records its ready text, and a setup that exits early is reported by its own exit code and refusal.
